name: Arbitrage
summary: This EA implements a triangular arbitrage strategy across EURUSD, GBPUSD, and EURGBP currency pairs. It monitors the price difference between the synthetic EURGBP rate (derived from EURUSD/GBPUSD) and the actual EURGBP market rate, entering a three-legged arbitrage position when the spread exceeds commission costs. Trades are opened simultaneously in all three pairs to capture the pricing inefficiency.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了一个跨EURUSD、GBPUSD和EURGBP三个货币对的三角套利策略。它监控合成的EURGBP汇率（由EURUSD/GBPUSD推导）与实际EURGBP市场汇率之间的价差，当价差超过佣金成本时，同时在三个货币对开仓以捕获定价低效。
strategy_analysis: 该策略采用三角套利原理，通过比较合成汇率与实际汇率之间的差异来发现套利机会。入场条件：当EURUSD卖价/GBPUSD买价与EURGBP卖价的差额超过点差加三倍佣金成本时，卖出EURGBP（即卖出EURUSD、买入GBPUSD、买入EURGBP）；当EURUSD买价/GBPUSD卖价与EURGBP买价的反向差额超过成本时，买入EURGBP。出场条件：当检测到反向套利机会时，先平掉对应侧的仓位，再开反向仓位。仓位管理：根据账户余额按每千美元对应Lot_Size_Per_Thousand手数计算，并取该值与EURGBP最大手数的较小值。资金管理：通过CheckVolumeValue函数检查最小/最大手数限制、手数步长合规性以及可用保证金是否充足。然而，策略没有设置止损，且平仓逻辑仅在新的反向信号出现时触发，存在长期持仓风险。
strategy_analysis_en: This strategy employs triangular arbitrage by comparing the synthetic EURGBP rate (EURUSD ask / GBPUSD bid) against the actual EURGBP market rate to detect pricing inefficiencies. Entry conditions: when the difference between the synthetic rate and the actual EURGBP ask exceeds the spread plus triple commission costs, the EA sells EURGBP (sell EURUSD, buy GBPUSD, buy EURGBP); conversely, when the inverse difference exceeds costs, it buys EURGBP (buy EURUSD, sell GBPUSD, sell EURGBP). Exit conditions: when an opposite arbitrage signal appears, the EA first closes the corresponding side positions before opening the reverse leg. Position sizing is calculated based on account balance multiplied by Lot_Size_Per_Thousand per thousand dollars, capped at the EURGBP symbol's maximum volume. Money management includes the CheckVolumeValue function which validates minimum/maximum volume constraints, volume step compliance, and available free margin. However, the strategy lacks any stop-loss mechanism, and the closing logic only triggers upon detecting a reverse arbitrage signal, creating risk of prolonged open positions.

parameters.description_en: Whether to plot/log max spread for analysis

pros: 利用三角套利原理，理论上属于市场中性策略，风险相对方向性交易较低
考虑了交易佣金和点差成本，只有当套利利润超过成本时才入场，避免亏损交易
包含保证金检查和手数合规性验证，防止因资金不足或手数不规范导致下单失败
三腿同时开仓的设计符合套利交易的基本要求，确保锁定价差
pros_en: Employs triangular arbitrage which is theoretically market-neutral, carrying lower risk than directional trading
Accounts for commission and spread costs, only entering when arbitrage profit exceeds total costs
Includes margin check and volume compliance validation to prevent order failures due to insufficient funds or invalid lot sizes
Simultaneous three-leg execution design properly captures the pricing inefficiency as required by arbitrage logic
cons: 没有止损机制，如果套利价差持续不收敛，仓位将无限期持有并承受浮动亏损
存在拼写错误'GPBUSD'应为'GBPUSD'，导致该手数检查永远不会通过，买卖EURGBP方向的交易实际上被阻止
使用SymbolInfoDouble实时获取价格存在滑点风险，三腿无法同时成交时可能产生单边敞口
套利窗口在高效市场中极其短暂，OnTick级别的检测可能无法及时捕获机会
平仓逻辑在遍历PositionsTotal时可能因索引变化导致跳过某些仓位
cons_en: No stop-loss mechanism; if the price difference fails to converge, positions are held indefinitely with floating losses
Typo 'GPBUSD' instead of 'GBPUSD' in CheckVolumeValue calls causes volume validation to always fail for that symbol, effectively blocking the buy-EURGBP arbitrage leg from executing
Using SymbolInfoDouble for live prices introduces slippage risk; if all three legs cannot be filled simultaneously, unhedged exposure results
Arbitrage windows are extremely brief in efficient markets, and OnTick-level detection may not capture opportunities fast enough
Position closing logic iterating over PositionsTotal may skip positions due to index shifts when positions are closed during iteration
improvements: 修复'GPBUSD'拼写错误为'GBPUSD'，否则买入EURGBP方向的套利交易完全无法执行
添加止损或最大持仓时间限制，防止价差不收敛时长期持有亏损仓位
使用PositionGetTicket从后向前遍历仓位来平仓，避免删除元素导致索引跳过的问题
添加滑点控制和重试机制，确保三腿交易尽可能同时成交
考虑使用限价单而非市价单执行套利，以更好控制成交价格
improvements_en: Fix the 'GPBUSD' typo to 'GBPUSD', otherwise the buy-EURGBP arbitrage direction is completely non-functional
Add stop-loss or maximum holding period limits to prevent prolonged loss positions when spreads fail to converge
Iterate positions in reverse order (from total-1 to 0) when closing to avoid index skipping issues caused by position removal during iteration
Add slippage control and retry mechanisms to ensure all three legs are filled as simultaneously as possible
Consider using limit orders instead of market orders for arbitrage execution to better control fill prices

risk_points: 关键拼写错误'GPBUSD'导致买入EURGBP方向的套利交易完全无法执行，但相关代码仍会尝试开仓EURUSD和GBPUSD，可能造成单边敞口
没有止损机制，价差不收敛时仓位无限持有
三腿套利可能因滑点或部分成交导致未对冲的定向风险敞口
平仓遍历顺序错误可能导致部分仓位未被关闭
risk_points_en: Critical typo 'GPBUSD' causes the buy-EURGBP arbitrage path to fail validation, but the code still attempts to open EURUSD and GBPUSD positions, potentially creating unhedged directional exposure
No stop-loss mechanism; positions held indefinitely when price difference fails to converge
Three-leg arbitrage may result in unhedged directional exposure due to slippage or partial fills
Incorrect iteration order when closing positions may cause some positions to be skipped
